proposed_widenings.name: random_table_resolution
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic is a mandatory random roll that selects one of many heterogeneous outcomes. The current activation family has ordered phases and player choice, but no honest way to branch by die-result.
proposed_widenings.evidence: That location becomes the point of origin of a spell or other magical effect determined by rolling on the Wand of Wonder Effects table.

proposed_widenings.name: activation_phase.random_embedded_spell_cast
proposed_widenings.justification: Several table results immediately cast a spell from the wand with item-specific overrides: fixed save DC 15, chosen point of origin, and range extension to 120 feet. Existing grant_spell_access grants persistent access to cast a spell; it does not model an immediate item-resolved cast with overridden spell parameters.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You cast a spell originating from the chosen point... Spells cast from the wand have a save DC of 15. If a spell's maximum range is normally less than 120 feet, it becomes 120 feet when cast from the wand.

proposed_widenings.name: obscure_area
proposed_widenings.justification: Two deterministic non-spell outcomes create temporary areas that are Lightly Obscured or Heavily Obscured. The current effect vocabulary has conditions, senses, and movement changes, but no area-obscurement effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: During that time, the area of effect is Lightly Obscured... the area of effect is Heavily Obscured.

notes: Do not author a placeholder record. The charge-pool shell fits existing magic-item activation mechanics, but the actual payload does not. Beyond the random-table blocker, secondary unsupported branches include immediate non-spell transformations/exile/summons and GM-random subject selection.
